d: Bihar ke katihar jile men katihar-manihari mukhy sarak phorlen par narayanpur ke samip shukravar ahle subah karib 5 baje ek behad dardanak sarak hadsa ho gaya. manihari ganga snan karne aa rahe ek parivar ki kar sarak kinare khare kharab balu lade trak se pichhe se jordar takra gaee. is bhishan durghatna men danpti samet tin logon ki mauke par hi maut ho gaee, jabki tin any log ganbhir rup se ghayal ho gae.
